_comment: CDriveSentinel config. data_root is relative to the project folder (where src/ lives), so the project works on any drive/machine. exclude_paths lists folders that are never scanned (absolute, or relative to the data folder); the tool's own data folder is added automatically when it sits on the monitored volume. data_budget_mb is a hard cap on the tool's own footprint: past it, the oldest history is dropped (archives -> USN detail -> old inventory) instead of growing on a full C:. skip_paths is the legacy name for exclude_paths and is still honoured.

wiztree.note: P1 diffs by NTFS file ID; WizTree CSV has no FRN column, so P1 uses the built-in scanner.
